title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
abstract: arXiv:2610.34027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. translated_title: GEPA合并何时有效？一种机制层面的诊断
translated_abstract: GEPA是目前针对语言模型程序最强的反思式提示优化器之一，但其系统感知的合并算子在跨模型场景下表现不稳定：合并操作平均上能提升gpt-4.1-mini的性能，却会降低Qwen3-8B的表现——GEPA论文注意到了这一不对称性，但未给出解释。我们在五个数据集和两个模型上研究了这种不稳定性。我们对合并时机和合并算子进行的九种配置扫描表明，在合理配置下，合并可以同时提升两个模型的性能。这表明合并的不稳定性更适合用配置敏感性来解释，而非合并算子本身的固有缺陷。随后，我们测试了提示层特征能否预测GEPA的合并接受决策，结果发现不能，从而排除了静态特征门控的可能性。作为概念验证，基于这些诊断构建的一个基于行为的探测器，在我们的多种子运行中通过对高风险任务采取弃权策略来避免大规模合并失败，尽管它并不能始终一致地（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过系统性诊断发现，GEPA合并算子的跨模型不稳定性源于配置敏感性而非算子本身的固有缺陷，并构建了一个基于行为的探测器，通过对高风险任务弃权来避免合并失败。
en_tdlr: This mechanism-level diagnostic shows that GEPA's merge instability across models stems from configuration sensitivity rather than an inherent flaw in the merge operator, and demonstrates a behavior-based probe that avoids large merge failures by abstaining on high-risk tasks.
